bh metrics --json [--window today|7d|30d|all] (default 7d) prints {"window":"7d","from":ISO|null,"to":ISO,"totals":{"timeMs":n,"turns":n,"tokens":{"input":n,"output":n,"cacheRead":n,"cacheWrite":n},"costUsd":n,"tasks":n,"steps":n,"estimated":{"tokens":bool,"cost":bool}},"agents":[{"id":"dev","name":"Dev","role":"dev","harness":"pi","models":["…"],"timeMs":n,"turns":n,"tokens":{"input":n,"output":n,"cacheRead":n,"cacheWrite":n},"costUsd":n|null,"tasks":n,"steps":n,"estimated":{"tokens":bool,"cost":bool},"daily":[{"day":"YYYY-MM-DD","timeMs":n,"turns":n}]}]}. agents sorted by timeMs desc; id = role for built-in agents, slug(name) for custom ones; spawn names (dev-lean, qa-gate2) roll up to their agent; daily has one entry per day in the window (today: 1, 7d: 7, 30d and all: last 30), oldest first; costUsd null only when neither reported nor estimable; tokens numbers include estimates when estimated.tokens is true.

Skills (steps 9-11). (a) task.json and plan.json gain "skills": {"<agent id>": {"picked": string[] | null, "added": string[]}} where agent id = role for built-in agents, slug(name) for custom ones; picked null = classifier off or failed (only pins apply), [] = no extra skills. bh task show <id> --json and bh plan show <id> --json include it. (b) Each task step started by bh spawn gains "skills": {"pinned": string[], "picked": string[], "added": string[], "fallback": bool} (what that spawn was allowed). (c) bh tools --list --json prints [{"key":"claude","name":"Claude Code","supported":true}, …] for every harness the engine knows; bh tools <harness> --json is unchanged.

Step 11 UI: the Tasks page draws steps from bh task list --all --json, whose steps carry only n,title,agent,status,started,finished,workedMs,note,report,timeMs,usage. For the step 'Skills:' line, steps[].skills (contract #9 b) must also be in task list, not only task show. Also bh tools --list --json is not in yet (returns the harness object), so Settings keeps the fixed supported sentence until it is.

Steps 2/3/4 + engine half of 12 are in the tree (dev-lean). Contracts others build on: (1) a child's report contract (path, bh report, hc send) lives in the brief's '## Reporting'; bh spawn's about only points there, so nothing is said twice; (2) between tasks, bh task status <id> done and bh plan task write DATA/sessions/compact-pending.json {at, reason, task}; the lead's agent terminal consumes it before the next message and compacts Claude Code headless with claude -p '/compact' --resume <session> --output-format stream-json --verbose (verified, Claude Code 2.1.328), else starts a new session with a '## Handoff' line per step; children ignore the marker; (3) the skills cache is now invalidated by a changed skills/plugins folder mtime, not by forcing refresh; (4) new derived file .bot-herdr/tasks/<id>/usage-totals.json caches a done task's totals (safe to commit or ignore). Two assertions outside my file list had to change for these behaviours: test/engine.test.mjs (child brief has no '## Child agents') and test/tools.test.mjs (a new skill folder invalidates the cache). npm test: 287 tests, 286 pass, 1 skip, 0 fail; bh check PASS.

Skills engine is in (dev-lean): (1) task.json and plan.json carry skills { id: { picked: string[] | null, added: [] } } — id is the role, a custom agent's slug; bh task new asks triage+skills in one classifier request for every non-lead agent, bh plan new picks once for the seats (dev, design, qa, research, custom agents); classifier off/failed = picked null for all. (2) steps[].skills = { pinned, picked, added, fallback } set when bh spawn --task/--step starts a step, present in bh task list --all --json and task show. (3) bh spawn --skill <name> (repeatable, needs --task or --panel) appends to that record's added. (4) allowlist at launch = pins ∪ picked ∪ added: picked null keeps pins-only behaviour, a picked array (even []) denies every installed skill/MCP outside it — Claude Code via --settings deny, Codex MCP via -c, other harnesses by the brief's 'Use only these skills: … If you need another, post a blocker naming it.' (5) bh tools --list --json prints { key, name, supported } for every known harness; supported now claude, codex, opencode, gemini, qwen, antigravity, pi (omp unverified, unsupported). npm test 325 tests, 324 pass, 1 skip; bh check PASS.

Metrics amendment (QA finding 1): in bh metrics --json, an agent or totals "tokens" is null (not zeros) when no turn in it reported tokens and none could be estimated, and "costUsd" is null when nothing was reported or priced (totals included). The UI shows "—" for null tokens and null cost.

QA gate fixes by dev-lean (engine side): (1) contract #24 done — bh metrics --json gives tokens:null when no turn reported tokens and none was estimated, and costUsd:null when nothing was reported or priced, for agents AND totals; Design owns the '—' rendering. (2) compact-pending.json now carries { project, kind: 'done'|'planned', plan?, task, reason }; only mode lead + agent.lead of the same project root consumes it, other 'lead' agents (direct chats, Scout) and other projects leave it; planned handoff says 'Previous plan <plan title> became task <task title>; it starts now.', done handoffs keep '<title>: done.'. (3) bh plan task copies plan.skills onto the task (uncovered agents get picked:null), and allowedFor merges entry.added into the pins when picked is null with pins present; no pins still means no restriction. (4) skill questions are keyed skills.<id>, a choice must start <role>. before slicing, team.mjs uses projectRoot(), plan new tells the classifier the seats are read-only (no write/deploy skills). npm test 334 tests, 333 pass, 1 skip; bh check PASS.
